name: huawei-clouddevops
description: Interact with the full Huawei CloudDevOps (云捷) platform via the remote `clouddevops-mcpserver` MCP server (tool.clouddevops.huawei.com). 65 tools spanning issues/bugs (full lifecycle), requirements (RR/FE), workitems (Feature/Story), vulnerabilities, Wiki docs, design articles, labels, COE, and release plans. Requires X-AUTH-TOKEN for all tool calls. Remote HTTP endpoint — install-free (pure-stdlib wrapper), but not credential-free. Usable by any MCP-capable agent (load the bundled config) or any agent with Bash + Python 3 (run the bundled wrapper script).

network.note: The endpoint is on the Huawei intranet. It must bypass the corporate HTTP proxy (proxyuk.huawei.com:8080) or the connection fails. The wrapper script sets NO_PROXY automatically via a no-proxy opener; when loading the MCP config into an agent, ensure NO_PROXY includes tool.clouddevops.huawei.com.

auth_detail: X-AUTH-TOKEN required for all tool calls (the handshake + tools/list work without it, but every tools/call returns 401 without a valid token). Set CLOUDDEVOPS_X_AUTH_TOKEN in the environment (wrapper) or X-AUTH-TOKEN in the headers (config).
